notes.title: Update 07.09.2025 Library
notes.content: [p]⬖ Added Library that features a new Timeflow mechanic and unites all lore and art in one place:[/p][p]❯ After the first Rebirth, use Insight to activate Timeflow and skip time forward, collecting all the rewards.[/p][p]❯ Use Merit to upgrade the length of Timeflow. notes.title: Launch week recap and what's next
notes.content: [h2]Launch week[/h2][p]For me as a developer of a free game, the key performance indicator (KPI) is player engagement and enjoyment with Four Divine Abidings. It tells me if it makes sense in further development or is it better to move on. For the first week, this KPI can be summarized in the following numbers:[/p][p][/p][p]⬖ 418 daily active players.[/p][p]⬖ 10h 5m median play time.[/p][p]⬖ 79 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3834680/Four_Divine_Abidings_Supporter/"]Supporters[/url].[/p][p]⬖ 21, 90% positive [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3655580/Four_Divine_Abidings/#app_reviews_hash"]reviews[/url].[/p][p]⬖ Ongoing engagement:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611635/176eb3673dd65a8b2d15a1a6b6b6d3d5d41d6b54.png"][/img][/p][p]I'm thankful for the feedback and suggestions provided, which have already resulted in game updates improving the players' experience ([url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3655580/view/670589610075619871?l=english"]1[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3655580/view/670589610075619520?l=english"]2[/url]). I'd like to specifically thank people who provided this feedback as well as those who wrote extensive reviews covering different aspects of the game, including the theme - I experienced appreciative joy reading them ([i]Mudita[/i] :) ).[/p][p]I've recently added [url="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3527049699"]Beginner Insights[/url] which cover some of the early game basics to make first steps smoother.[/p][p][/p][h2]What's next[/h2][p]Given such engagement, I'm happy to continue the development, integrating the feedback and ideas that you provided. I've thematically grouped some of them:[/p][p]⬖ A glossary, where every term, whether game systems or lore related, can be easily searched for.[/p][p]⬖ A place where all uncovered game lore can be easily viewed again.[/p][p]⬖ Real meditation instructions with a timer.[/p][p]All of these fit well into a Library - an addition to the game I will focus on. It will take some time to develop, so I'll make sure to still implement smaller suggesstions and improvements while this bigger add-on is being developed.[/p][p]I'm also working on Mac support: while the build is ready, there are restrictions that Apple implemented for developers of the country I'm from. If you are enrolled in the Apple developer program and would like to assist in signing the game - kindly contact me in [url="https://discord.com/invite/CujAfXU3ZS"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][h2]Thanks for playing ❤️[/h2][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🪷🪷 The Journey starts now 🪷🪷
notes.content:
[h2]Four Divine Abidings is now available on Steam[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Steam release highlights[/b][/h3][p]⬖ 33 Steam achievements.[/p][p]⬖ Cloud save support.[/p][p]⬖ Linux support. Steam Deck support awaiting confirmations by players.[/p][p]⬖ Save games import support from/to web version.
[/p][h3][b]Game Highlights[/b][/h3][p]⬖ Narrated gameplay with [b]dozens of tasks[/b] to follow.[/p][p]⬖ The game is [b]content-complete[/b] and can be finished.[/p][p]⬖ [b]202 Milestones[/b] to claim, many providing unique permanent buffs.[/p][p]⬖ [b]32 Skills[/b] and [b]Insights [/b]to master.[/p][p]⬖ Additional [b]16 Skills for Rebirth[/b] mechanic.[/p][p]⬖ [b]9 Spiritual Tools[/b] introducing new mechanics and game loops.[/p][p]⬖ Full support of both [b]idle [/b]and [b]active [/b]playstyles.[/p][p]⬖ Many intertwined, evolving layers of [b]strategic progression[/b] to keep you engaged throughout the whole game experience.[/p][p]⬖ Optional 2x speed for a faster-paced experience.[/p][p]⬖ [b]Hand-painted art[/b], which many people find beautiful. Hand-painted compilation: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kHXQim-t5vo"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]A Free Game[/b][/h3][p]I got a valuable opportunity to make a free game. This means there is no a slightest conflict of interest: [/p][p]⬖ All quality of life features are available from the beginning.[/p][p]⬖ All content is accessible for free.[/p][p]⬖ Fair offline calculations upgradable up to 52 hours.[/p][p]⬖ No pay-inducing progress walls.[/p][p]
There is an optional [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3834680/Four_Divine_Abidings_Supporter/"]$5 Supporter DLC[/url][/u] introduced for those who wish to express their gratitude; 100% of proceeds will go to [url="https://godotengine.org"]godotengine.org[/url] - an engine where the game was crafted, free and open source.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Have a wonderful Journey[/b] [b]❤️[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611635/8644c5af5718c9db7856e91d800bf6e8712e09f9.png"][/img][/p]
